title: Charon ferryman myth comes from the Epic of Gilgamesh

plain: A researcher named Matt says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the Greek myth of Charon, the ferryman who takes the dead across the river Styx into the underworld, came from the Epic of Gilgamesh, an ancient poem from Mesopotamia. He calls that poem the oldest recorded version of the idea, which would make the Greek myth a much older story passed down.
